deadline.value: International applicants are encouraged to apply by December 15, 2026 so transcripts arrive in time; the program deadline is April 4, 2027.
deadline.quote: International applicants and applicants with international transcripts are encouraged to apply by December 15th

app_fee.value: The EEB page gives the international application fee as $95.
app_fee.quote: Pay the $65 Domestic or $95 International application fee in the online application system.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Acceptance into EEB requires the support of a faculty mentor, so you must contact a potential advisor before the deadline.
supervisor.quote: Your acceptance into the EEB program requires the support of a faculty mentor, be sure to contact a potential faculty advisor before the application deadline.

funding.value: Teaching assistantships that include a stipend, tuition and fee waiver are available only on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Teaching Assistantships that include a stipend, tuition, and fee waiver, and student health insurance may be available to Ph.D. EEB students on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: The EEB application pages do not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: The April 4 deadline is for fall start. Applicants must also submit a cover letter and identify faculty advisors in the Applicant Faculty Advisor Selection form. The EEB page does not list the GRE among required materials.
